statement: For any sphere S_R in the local exterior, define mu_obs(R) by the normalized Gauss flux of Phi_obs in the same observed frame used by test-body readout.
derivation: This is a definition of the measured monopole at radius R; it is not yet equal to G_eff M_H.
formula: mu_obs(R) := N_G int_{S_R} n^i partial_i Phi_obs dS

statement: Between two homologous exterior spheres, the difference of measured monopoles equals the shell integral of every non-Hilbert or non-descended exterior source plus boundary/reference flux.
derivation: Apply Stokes/Gauss to the reduced exterior field equation in divergence form, keeping all residual operators rather than hiding them in G.

statement: Taking R1 outside the compact Hilbert source and R2 at the comparison/readout surface gives mu_obs=G_eff M_H+sum_i Q_i.
derivation: The 3773 Hamiltonian/Gauss bridge supplies G_eff M_H; all remaining shell or surface terms are defined as Q_i components of mu_extra.

statement: Any radial, temporal, range, species, or frame dependence of measured GM is the corresponding derivative of G_eff M_H plus the derivative of the Q_i sum.
derivation: Differentiate the component identity; this is the no-hair test interface.
formula: partial_a ln mu_obs = partial_a ln(G_eff M_H) + partial_a mu_extra/mu_obs
